listing.name: Hybrid Heaven: Recompiled (ogdanimal)
listing.summary: Hybrid Heaven on Windows, Linux and Android, using your own USA cartridge dump. The game checks and copies it on first launch; saves and settings stay in its own profile.

warnings: The package includes Chiaro fonts by Fontworks that the project license does not cover, and fan-made launcher background and icon artwork credited in the project README. Portcove downloads the package only from the project’s own releases. You need your own original game files.
Portcove has not observed native setup, gameplay or saves. On Linux the player needs a Vulkan driver, SDL2 and GTK 3.

steps.title: Supply your original on first Play
steps.instruction: Choose Play. First launch asks once for your own ordinary USA Hybrid Heaven cartridge dump (upstream SHA-1 16dbc21620b52deab5c5abf8a309ac60adfbee85). The game checks it and copies it into its own profile, then offers Start Game. No decompression or converter is needed. Keep your original separately.

steps.title: Keep the complete package
steps.instruction: For a copy you manage yourself, keep the complete upstream package in a folder you control and start HybridHeavenRecompiled.exe on Windows or HybridHeavenRecompiled on Linux from that folder, with assets beside it. To add that copy to Portcove, select the player and its folder; removing it from Portcove leaves every file in place. Android APK installation remains an upstream device setup route.

references.title: Keep the game profile when updating
references.instruction: Close the game and back up its profile before changing versions: normally %LOCALAPPDATA%\HybridHeavenRecompiled on Windows or ~/.config/HybridHeavenRecompiled on Linux. A copy with portable.txt uses its own folder instead, and a Linux copy started with APP_FOLDER_PATH uses the folder that variable names. The profile holds the copied original, settings, saves and mods. The game can import a compatible save through Settings → Saves before starting; its existing save is kept as hybridheaven.us.bin.pre-import.bak. Controller Pak .mpk files are not accepted by that importer. Check progress in the new copy before retiring the old one.

presentation.manual_preparation: On first Play, the game asks once for your own USA Hybrid Heaven cartridge dump, checks it and keeps a copy in its profile, together with saves, settings and mods; keep your original separately. The profile is %LOCALAPPDATA%\HybridHeavenRecompiled on Windows and ~/.config/HybridHeavenRecompiled on Linux. Portcove starts the managed copy without APP_FOLDER_PATH, so a Linux copy you run with APP_FOLDER_PATH keeps a separate profile; a copy you manage yourself without portable.txt or APP_FOLDER_PATH shares the managed profile. Portcove refuses to start a managed copy that contains portable.txt. Portcove neither backs up nor removes the profile, and rollback does not rewind it; back it up before changing versions. On Linux the player needs a Vulkan driver, SDL2 and GTK 3. Portcove replaces the player; you own the original and the profile.
